numerical_notes: CODATA electron mass-energy value is a correlated rounding cross-check with absolute allowance 5e-25 J; not independent data.

All other normalized identities use 80 digits and 1e-60 tolerance; root cross-check 1e-55.
Eigenmasses refer to scalar Hessian over K in Einstein proper-time normalization. Tensor G ratio is distinct from Ricci coefficient and Cavendish response.
No induced-curvature numerical coefficient or higher-derivative dynamics is supplied.
